notes: `אִשָּׁה זוֹנָה` → *a harlot* is read as a rule 30 fusion headed on `זוֹנָה`, rather than marking `אִשָּׁה` unrepresented beside a separately aligned `זוֹנָה`, which rule 30 forbids; the *a* is the nominal expression's under rule 15.
`גִּבּוֹר` → *a mighty man* heads on *mighty*, *man* being the generic the ASV supplies (rule 31); `חַיִל` keeps *of valor* under rule 19.
